outcome_neutrality_notice: This contract fixes what a cognitive unit MAY be and how it is measured. It does not assert which unit is the correct unit of intelligence. See COARSE_GRAINING_INDIVIDUALITY_V1.

m_i.heritable_via: I_epi or I_C only where permitted

organism_state.boundedness: Every component is bounded; unbounded organism state is not a legal configuration and yields CANNOT_CHECK on the recurrence ceiling BIO-T2.

protected_state_separation.rule: a_i is written only by assay machinery and read only by observer-side reporting.
protected_state_separation.structural_exclusion_is_necessary_not_su: Mirrors oracle/c_immutability.py: name-level exclusion must be paired with a live check. Here the live check is the ancestor closure BIO-NI-1, not a digest comparison.
protected_state_separation.why_a_digest_is_insufficient_here: A digest detects that protected state CHANGED. It does not detect that protected state was READ by a selection-relevant kernel. Leakage into selection is a read-path property, so it needs the write/read graph.

unit_candidacy.statement: An organism/cell index i is a bookkeeping index, not a claim that the individual is the unit of intelligence.
unit_candidacy.forbidden_inference: i exists therefore the individual is the cognitive unit

reuse.gap: no `maintenance` and no `human_external_input` bucket; see PARENT_LEDGER.md gap G2

burden_vector.non_netting_rule: The ledger only ever grows. Failed, infeasible, gate-failed and crashed evaluations are all charged. Nothing is netted off.

resource_matching.rule: Any comparison across organization classes is void unless all five axes are matched or the mismatch is declared and carried into the claim ceiling.
resource_matching.identifiability: Only the residual terms may support an organization-level claim. See BIO-T8.

knockout_semantics.rule: Causal attribution requires deletion of the exact inherited object or channel claimed to cause the gain, holding everything else fixed, and requires the advantage to weaken or disappear.
knockout_semantics.explicitly_insufficient: a correlated pre/post comparison, or post-evolution superiority alone

reuse.gap: knocks out inherited STORE FIELDS; a social/cultural CHANNEL knockout (I_h, I_o, I_pub) has no equivalent. See PARENT_LEDGER.md gap G3

knockout_semantics.external_warning: ANIL showed a signature mechanism can be inert while the system still performs. This is why knockout, not pre/post comparison, is the decisive test. Source: REVIVAL_BACKLOG_V1 RV-10 notes.
